title: Haoxiguan decoded sync AEAD envelope v1
description: JSON obtained after canonical Base64 decoding the opaque HTTP ciphertext string. The server transports that outer string; this object is the client envelope, not a new server API.

ciphertext.description: Canonical Base64 for 16..131088 cipher bytes; the maximum is exactly representable because 131088 is divisible by three. Authentication and available generation checks remain runtime.

wireString.description: SyncCrypto.encrypt return value and HTTP ciphertext. contentSchema/contentEncoding are annotations; a validator must explicitly decode UTF-8 JSON and validate the envelope.
